messages:
Lina: Heads-up: webinar deck needs a single "one-sentence" takeaway slide focused on latency vs unit economics. Can we avoid >4 bullets?
Harper: Agreed. Proposed visual: layered scatter (points = configs) + a log-scaled cost axis, tiny p99 inset. Keep the takeaway line large.
Devon: Data check: latest run shows median latency improvements on Dedicated w/ cache enabled. Numbers in bench artifact. Will add sample prompt mix.
BenchBot: Uploaded artifacts: https://bench.redwood/runs/6112233445.csv; quick stats -> hosted median=105ms p99=430ms $/1k=3.6; dedicated median=72ms p99=155ms $/1k=2.1. Methodology blob in notes.
DesignOps: I'll mock two variants: Variant A (emphatic takeaway + simplified chart), Variant B (detailed annotations + small FAQ). Which audience? execs vs devs?
Lina: Execs get A, webinar landing + follow-up get B as downloadable appendix. We need an easy-to-scan CTA: "See full methodology" and "Request dedicated trial".
Harper: Copy suggestion for slide: "Lower median latency and predictable tail, at reduced unit cost for reserved infra". Avoid absolute claims.
Devon: Methodology snippet to paste in slide notes:
```json
{"models":["rw-open-3b","rw-open-7b"],"seq_len":512,"batching":"dynamic","cache":"prefix_kv","quant":"int8"}
```
GrowthLead: Routing plan: webinar -> marketing-nurture; "Request dedicated trial" -> sales.sdr queue with tag bench_heatmap_6112; methodology clicks -> docs.utm=heatmap_6112. Also add lead scoring rule for p99-sensitive customers.
Lina: Good. Also prep two email subject lines for the invite: 1) "See where speed meets token economics" 2) "How to lower token spend without sacrificing tail latency" — leaning 1. A/B test?
GrowthLead: A/B test both, measure CTR and demo requests. Add utm_content=heatmap_subjectA/B.
DesignOps: Uploading Figma frames in a few hours: https://fig.redwood/heatmap/6112233445. Will include color legend for Hosted vs Dedicated.
Devon: Quick FAQ lines for slide appendix: 1) "Which workloads benefit most?" -> token-heavy generation + chat. 2) "How to replicate results?" -> see methodology link + repo.
BenchBot: Repro doc: https://confluence.redwood/bench/repro/6112233445. Checksum sha256: d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e.
Lina: Action items: DesignOps - two Figma variants; Devon - paste callouts + FAQ; GrowthLead - YAML for routing + utm specs; BenchBot - confirm artifact perms. I'll assemble the takeaway slide and circulate Friday morning. :raised_hands:
Harper: One more: add small note on model variant fallbacks and how routing chooses cheaper variants under load. People will ask about quality regressions.
Lina: Add a single-sentence caveat in fine print. Done.
